smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: ArchiVinci
shortDescription: Renders floor plans and furnishes a 2D plan. Monthly access is $79.
longDescription: ArchiVinci lists interior, exterior, landscape, floor plan, and masterplan renders, plus furnishing a 2D floor plan and image-to-3D floor plan generation. A monthly subscription is $79. A yearly subscription is $549. A 3-day pass is $49.
pricingNotes: Monthly subscription is $79. Yearly subscription is $549. A 3-day pass is $49. A 1-month pass is $99.
bestFor: A 2D floor plan you want furnished and rendered
Floor plan, exterior, and masterplan renders in one suite
notIdealFor: A free trial with no payment
Virtual staging of one listing photo
strength: ArchiVinci renders floor plans, furnishes a 2D floor plan, and can generate a 3D floor plan from an image.
weakness: The monthly subscription is $79, and the pricing page does not list a free tier.

useCaseFit.floor-plan-rendering: Renders a floor plan and furnishes a 2D plan.
